description_en: Describes the network partition configurations for multiple Kubernetes clusters in a Service Mesh instance
description_zh: 获取服务网格中多个Kubernetes集群的网络分区配置描述
name: DescribeMeshMultiClusterNetwork

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

additionalProperties.description_en: The network partition configuration for the cluster
additionalProperties.description_zh: 集群的网络分区配置描述

CustomGatewayAddress.description_en: The custom endpoint of the east-west gateway. The value must be in the \`ip:port\` format
CustomGatewayAddress.description_zh: 自定义的东西向网关访问地址。格式为ip:port

EnableGateway.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the east-west gateway for the cluster.

true: The east-west gateway is enabled.
false: The east-west gateway is disabled
EnableGateway.description_zh:
是否为该集群开启东西向网关访问。

true：开启东西向网关访问
false：关闭东西向网关访问

GatewayName.description_en: The name of the east-west gateway that provides cross-cluster access
GatewayName.description_zh: 为集群提供跨集群访问的东西向网关名称

Network.description_en: The name of the network partition

MultiClusterNetworks.description_en: The network partition configurations for multiple Kubernetes clusters. The key is the cluster ID, and the value is the network partition configuration for the cluster
MultiClusterNetworks.description_zh: 多个Kubernetes集群的网络分区配置描述，map的键为Kubernetes集群的集群id、值为该集群的网络分区配置
